replies.author: @HappyTravel99
replies.text:
Not a strange question at all. If someone passes away in Antarctica, the usual procedure is to return them home as soon as transport and weather conditions allow. During the harsh winter, that can sometimes take quite a while.
As for your second question, there has not been a confirmed murder case in Antarctica that I’m aware of. And I hope you do get to visit one day — it would certainly be an unforgettable experience. ❄️❤️
